items.title: Bassett Furniture Indus Q3 2026 Earnings Call: Complete Transcript
items.summary: Bassett Furniture Industries reported a 3.4% increase in consolidated revenue for Q3 2026, driven by growth in both retail and wholesale sales, and improved gross margins by 130 basis points partly due to tariff refunds. The company is focusing on retail expansion, e-commerce growth, and product innovation through partnerships, while maintaining a strong liquidity position despite challenges in the housing market and high inflation. Management remains optimistic, having implemented new pricing strategies and expense reductions to improve future margins.

items.title: TotalEnergies to invest $10 billion in Argentina, CEO Pouyanne says
items.summary: TotalEnergies plans to invest $10 billion in Argentina across various projects, including new wells in Tierra del Fuego and expanding gas production in Neuquen, aiming to increase daily gas production to 16 million cubic meters. The investment underscores Argentina's efforts to attract foreign capital, particularly for its Vaca Muerta shale formation, a key driver of the country's energy growth and future export revenue. CEO Patrick Pouyanne made the announcement during an investment conference in Paris, coinciding with Argentine President Javier Milei's visit to France to promote investment opportunities.

items.title: Banc of California strengthens post-merger with PacWest and $400M capital boost, improving portfolio and risk management.
items.summary: Banc of California has significantly strengthened its position after merging with PacWest and receiving a $400 million capital injection. This strategic move allowed the bank to proactively reposition its portfolio, shortening asset durations and reinvesting at higher yields to prepare for inflation and recession. With robust post-merger procedures and a focus on profitability and risk control, Banc of California aims for enhanced stability and growth, mitigating potential economic uncertainties.

items.summary: This article reviews the Q2 earnings of electronic components & manufacturing stocks, highlighting TTM Technologies (NASDAQ:TTMI) and its peers. The report details the performance of TTM Technologies, Amphenol, Rogers, Plexus, and Jabil, noting their revenue growth and market reactions.

items.title: Dollar Tree gains new bull as bargains lure in more 'well-heeled' customers
items.summary: Loop Capital upgraded Dollar Tree (DLTR) to Buy from Hold, increasing its price target to $140 due to an anticipated increase in bargain hunting and a "stepped-up" stockholder return. The analyst believes Dollar Tree will benefit from consumers trading down from higher-priced alternatives and that its multi-price selection strategy is sustainable. Increased share buybacks also contribute to the higher valuation, suggesting fundamental outperformance in a difficult economic environment.

items.title: U.S. added 90,000 jobs last month, says ADP—including in manufacturing and construction, where trade bosses say six-figure jobs are sitting empty
items.summary: ADP's latest report indicates the U.S. added 90,000 private sector jobs in September, with significant contributions from manufacturing and construction. Despite this growth, industry leaders like the Home Builders Institute (HBI) warn of a critical shortage of skilled tradespeople, emphasizing that high-paying blue-collar jobs are going unfilled. Economists are monitoring wage growth in these sectors, particularly construction, for potential inflation risks, while also noting the impact of worker sentiment on hiring challenges.

items.title: Cal-Maine Shares Crack After Wider-Than-Expected Loss, Muted Egg Prices
items.summary: Shares of Cal-Maine Foods Inc. dropped after the company reported wider-than-expected losses and soft first-quarter results for fiscal 2027. Analyst Pooran Sharma maintained an Equal-Weight rating but cut the price target due to lower gross margin, higher SG&A, and muted egg prices caused by industry supply imbalance, which is expected to persist through the holiday season. The company's net sales declined, and average selling prices for eggs fell significantly.

items.title: DTE completes 100MW Cold Creek Solar Park to support Ford's 100% renewable energy goal in Michigan
items.summary: DTE Energy has completed the 100-megawatt Cold Creek Solar Park in Michigan, a crucial step for Ford Motor Company to achieve its goal of using 100% renewable energy for its Michigan vehicle production by 2027. This project, funded through Ford's participation in DTE's MIGreenPower program, supports clean energy goals, local jobs, and tax revenue. Despite this positive development, Ford's stock performance reflects cautious market sentiment, showing only a modest 1-day gain.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Cuts Columbia Banking System (NASDAQ:COLB) Price Target to $33.00
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. has lowered its price target for Columbia Banking System (NASDAQ:COLB) to $33.00 from $35.00, while maintaining a "neutral" rating, implying a potential upside of 17.71%. This adjustment comes despite Columbia Banking System reporting quarterly earnings per share of $0.76, exceeding the consensus estimate of $0.73, though revenue fell short of expectations. The consensus among analysts remains a "Hold" rating with an average target price of $33.42, reflecting cautious sentiment, with five analysts rating it a "Buy" and eight a "Hold."

items.title: 5 ways Amazon is investing in New Jersey
items.summary: Amazon has invested over $55 billion in New Jersey, creating more than 42,000 direct jobs and supporting over 30,000 indirect jobs. The company focuses on employee development through programs like Career Choice, builds extensive infrastructure including fulfillment centers and Whole Foods Market locations, and empowers small businesses by providing access to millions of customers. Additionally, Amazon contributes to the community through significant donations and volunteer efforts.
